answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the basalt of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the prism re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
